card.name: Spots where "equal" could come next
card.fires_on: Small words or punctuation at places where the next word could plausibly be "equal" or "equally", such as after "distributed", "jurisdiction the" or "how many tenths are needed to". Also fires on some unrelated spots such as a list opening quote or a name title.

modes.description: Linking word just before "equal" in rights, pay or fairness wording.

modes.label: Make-one or equivalence math
modes.description: Word in a quantity question where equality or equivalence is implied.
modes.example: How many tenths are needed<< to>> make one? (10)

modes.label: Scattered mid-sentence words
modes.description: Commas, "also" or "about" in lists or counts, with no clear link to equality.
